decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisement display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 3 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission
Condition : 4 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 6 - The double sided advert panel hereby approved shall emit lighting as described in the specification (425 cd/m).
Condition : 7 - The proposed panels must not have any intermittent light source, animation, moving feature or exposed cold cathode tubing.

Condition : 8 - The footway and carriageway on Great Chertsey Road and the bus stop must not be blocked during the construction and maintenance of the proposal. Temporary obstruction during the installation must be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrian (inc. bus passengers), or obstruct the flow of traffic.

Condition : 9 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 10 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 11 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity
description: Installation of internally illuminated double sided static advertising panel on a relocated bus shelter.
